"'''Wampa'''" was the nickname of a [[TIE pilot/Legends|TIE pilot]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Black 11]] and attained the "Wampa" nickname for [[Water/Legends|icy]] precision in battle. The nickname was derived from<ref name="Black 11 Card" /> the [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]], a fearsome and [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] creature hailing from the ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="wampa">{{CSWECite|III|318|wampa ice creature}}</ref> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], and ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' is set around that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> "Wampa" was stationed aboard<ref name="Black 11 Card" /> the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and often served as an escort to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]],<ref name="Black 11 Card" /> the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[ST 321/Legends|ST 321]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "Wampa" nickname was established for the pilot of the Black 11 [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on a card for the [[2000]] ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. While the image depicts one of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] fighters<ref name="Black 11 Card" /> escorting ST 321 during Darth Vader's visit to the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the opening scene of the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> there was no confirmation that "Wampa" was operating Black 11 during those events. As such, this article avoids listing ''Return of the Jedi'' as a confirmed appearance for the pilot.
